note: Configured FUTURE output locations, not claims that these files exist. Absent sources render PENDING. Update the path if Capstan chooses a different output namespace; re-export automatically resolves completed sources.

v0_report.schema: aw.pc_v0_report: aggregates (dataset,metric) mean/realizations/minimum/maximum; cells finish cost

v0_harm.schema: aw.pc_harm_readout: pairs difference_of_arm_es99.original, positionwise.original.loss.mean_signed; cells readout.summary.original; sibling cost.json

v1_run.schema: aw.pc_v1_run: each cell checkpoint-100/300.json metrics.<metric>.value; finish.json elapsed_process_seconds

v1_harm.schema: PC-5 shared read_arm/pair schema, selection.positions=245237; four arms and two pairs, final 300 checkpoint only

slots.v0.<dataset>.<es|ret_es|ret_gs|ls>: PC-3 aggregates selector dataset + ES/RET-ES/RET-GS/LS, mean; suffix .realizations / .range reads realization values / min,max
slots.v0.<SE-A|SE-E>.seconds: sum PC-3 cells[*].finish.elapsed_process_seconds for arm (30 cells)
slots.v1.<dataset>.<100|300>.<metric>: SE-E minus SE-A checkpoint metrics.<ES|RET-ES|RET-GS|LS|near_miss|revision>.value; short key omits 300
slots.v1.<SE-A|SE-E>.seconds: sum PC-7 finish.elapsed_process_seconds for arm (2 cells; stream-engine seconds)
slots.<v0|v1>.<dataset>.harm_es99_difference: mean pairs[*].difference_of_arm_es99.original; difference of arm ES99s, not ES99 of paired losses
